[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Retire the AXE watchdogs and alias sase axe to sase scheduler[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]The sase service host is the only thing that starts, restarts, or [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]stops the scheduler from a CLI path: the ensure watchdog and its [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]systemd timer are gone, no agent wait heals axe, the axe-start [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]systemd scope wrapper and its doctor check are gone, `sase update` [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]/ `sase flag` / `sase plugin` restart the `scheduler` service proc [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]instead of the AXE daemon, `sase axe start|stop|restart|status` is [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]a documented alias of `sase scheduler`, and the direct AXE restart [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]machinery that those paths kept alive is deleted.[/#D7D7AF]
